component.name: OpenPremier
component.summary: Edit video with a professional timeline
Edita vídeo con una línea de tiempo profesional

description.p: OpenPremier is a free and open source non-linear video editor with the workflow editors already know: Source and Program monitors, a multi-track timeline with ripple, roll, slip, slide and rate stretch tools, three-point editing, keyframed effects, transitions, color correction, titles, an audio mixer and GPU rendering.

It provides read-only import of supported structures from Premiere Pro projects (.prproj), plus Final Cut Pro XML and OpenTimelineIO interchange. A familiar default shortcut map and import of .kys shortcut files help editors migrate workflows.

Automatic animated captions transcribed on this computer, with twelve styles that light up each word as it is said; proxies for smooth editing of camera footage, faster reversed clips, ten new video effects, five transitions and eight audio effects.
Fixes exporting on macOS and a crash on Linux systems without VAAPI, retries a failed hardware export with the software encoder, and uses the system videos and pictures folders on every platform.
A macOS package, a performance mode, automatic hardware video decoding, a choice of graphics API, and much faster playback and export of camera files.
Paste images from the clipboard with Ctrl+V straight into the project and the timeline, a regular log window, a slimmer logo and a ripple trim fix for out-of-sync linked clips.

New glow, glitch, shake, grain, film and VHS looks, zoom, spin, flash and light-leak transitions, drag-and-drop animation presets, and better Premiere Pro project import: unknown effects and transitions are replaced by the closest equivalent.

Pausable exports with a live preview of the rendered frames and a selectable output frame rate, crash recovery, a program log that can be enabled in Preferences, a full color picker, redesigned panel tabs and dialogs that open centered.
